usage: Used as a noun to name a dark shade of red. Example: 呢件衫係深紅色。
Often describes clothes, objects, or decorations when you want to say the colour is darker than normal red. Example: 我買咗深紅色嘅袋。
Can be used after a noun phrase to say the thing is dark red in colour. Example: 朵花係深紅色。
A simple everyday colour word; it is neutral and can be used in both casual talk and writing. Example: 佢鍾意深紅色嘅手機殼。
